svg.title: Caspar Transfer Station to Mitchell Creek - Caspar station excluded
svg.desc: North-up 4:3 vector map, with approximately fifteen percent ocean on the left. Roads, waterways, and developed-residential parcel coverage match the county map's baseline excluding the locally added Caspar station. Orange outlines identify parcels that lose coverage without Caspar and are not within five modeled road miles of another included station. Green parcels are within five modeled road miles of a station; red parcels are coverage gaps. Dashed parcel outlines indicate inferred access. Counts are not a verified dwelling inventory.
